thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT host/hosted-api/us-west-2: sustained queue growth. current queue +540 requests, p95=5.6s, p99=27.1s. alert rule: hosted.queue.depth > 300 for 3m. dashboard: https://internal.redwood/d/hosted-queue

jon_oncall: acked. taking pager. looking into autoscaler and GPU pool state.

jon_oncall: quick findings: GPU autoscaler hitting provider errors when requesting new instances. sample error:
```
ERROR 2026-03-15T23:03:02Z autoscaler.provision: provider-api -> 403 ProviderQuotaExceeded: quota limit reached for family "a100". trace=bb6f2
```

alex_sre: do we have spare prewarmed nodes?

jon_oncall: reserved standby pool shows 6 GPUs but pool is reserved/dedicated and not attached to hosted cluster by default. attaching requires emergency approval.

maria_support: customers impacted: cluster-wide: several customers see timeouts; top offending tenants by QPS: trial-zetta, trial-oracle, partner-mapper (~68% of burst). AE for trial-zetta notified.

alex_sre: mitigation plan, ordered by rollback risk:
- A) attach reserved standby pool to hosted cluster for 2h (fast)
- B) enable model fallback to quantized-small variants for non-SLA tenants (low risk)
- C) emergency per-key concurrency caps for top offenders (aggressive, will cause 429s)
- D) cross-region spill to us-east-1 for non-enterprise traffic (adds latency)

jon_oncall: starting B then A. applying fallback first to reduce tail while approval for attach completes.

jon_oncall: applying route fallback policy:
```
redctl route set hosted/gpt --fallback=gpt-medium-q4 --fallback_threshold=200ms --selector=tenant_tier!=enterprise
```

ops-bot: route update queued and applied.

jon_oncall: seeing small improvement in p95 after fallback: p95=2.0s but p99 still ~9s and queue at +320.

cloud-ops: pinged provider support; quota bump request opened ticket PROVIDER-7891. ETA unknown (standard 3-8h).

alex_sre: while we wait we should attach standby pool. Maria - can you confirm customer priority for using reserved GPUs? we should prefer not to route enterprise traffic to reserved pool if it's meant for dedicated customers.

maria_support: enterprises: infra-inc and bluefin should not be impacted. trial-zetta, trial-oracle are trial tenants. bluefin is not part of this region active usage. go ahead with attach for trial mitigation. I'll notify AEs.

jon_oncall: requesting emergency attach:
```
ops-api pool attach --pool reserved-hosted-standby --cluster hosted-us-west-2 --duration 2h --reason "emergency: provider quota exhausted"
```

ops-bot: pool attach request received. Approval required by emergency-approver group. Approver pinged.

sre-bot: automated policy check: reserved-hosted-standby has contract flag=dedicated_only. Emergency attach will break SLA for dedicated customers. Proceeding requires explicit approval.

alex_sre: I'm approving emergency attach for 2h to stabilize production. Approver note: monitor dedicated customer usage for regressions.

ops-bot: emergency approval recorded: user=alex_sre. pool attach proceeding.

ops-bot: reserved-hosted-standby attached. +6 GPUs added to hosted-us-west-2 cluster.

jon_oncall: after attach: queue depth dropping fast. p95 1.1s, p99 2.9s, queue +42. Good.

maria_support: contacting trial-zetta AE: they confirm burst was from onboarding test harness. They will smooth traffic and throttle their load.

alex_sre: next step apply temporary per-key concurrency caps for the three highest QPS keys. This prevents a single tenant from monopolizing prewarmed capacity.

jon_oncall: applying caps:
```
redctl tenant update trial-zetta --concurrency-limit=8
redctl tenant update trial-oracle --concurrency-limit=6
redctl tenant update partner-mapper --concurrency-limit=6
```

ops-bot: concurrency caps applied. Response behavior: excess requests will receive 429 + Retry-After header.

jon_oncall: metrics after caps: p95=0.9s p99=1.6s queue=6. Stabilized.

alex_sre: we still need to capture root cause: why did autoscaler suddenly hit quota? possibilities: provider-side quota earlier reduced, multiple internal jobs requesting same family, or we hit organizational limit. Open follow-up: AUTOSCALE-2026-12.

jon_oncall: creating incident ticket INC-2026-042: "hosted: queue spike -> provider quota blocked autoscale". added timeline, commands, customer list. link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-042

maria_support: status update drafted for status.redwood.com: "Degraded performance in us-west-2 due to capacity saturation. Mitigations applied (fallbacks, emergency pool attach). Services stable; targeted customers were rate-limited. Next update in 2h." I'll send to affected AEs now.

cloud-ops: provider support replied: note that a recent quota re-org consolidated quotas under org root; our request routed to a parent quota pool which had limits. They're expediting review.

alex_sre: long-term actions to add to postmortem:
- add autoscaler alert for provider quota error class (403 ProviderQuotaExceeded)
- implement prewarm policy: keep N standby GPUs in each region (configurable by traffic tier)
- implement automated tenant soft-throttles when single-key > X% of cluster QPS
- add runbook step: check provider org quotas during scaling failures
- review reserved pool contract flags to allow emergency attach without operator approval for SEV1/SEV2

jon_oncall: handoff to alex_sre in 90m. I'll capture full timeline and mitigation steps in INC-2026-042.

alex_sre: taking over. will coordinate with cloud-ops for quota clarification and with product for any customer quality regressions due to fallback.

maria_support: AE for trial-zetta replies: they accepted transient 429s and will coordinate to smooth onboarding load. Thanks.

ops-bot: collecting logs for window 2026-03-15T23:01:00Z -> 2026-03-16T00:00:00Z. artifacts uploaded to INC-2026-042.

incident-bot: INC-2026-042 status changed to stabilized. severity downgraded SEV3 -> MONITOR. handlers=[jon_oncall,alex_sre]. next update scheduled in 3h.

jon_oncall: signing off active pager. leaving handoff notes in the incident doc. good job team. :white_check_mark:

alex_sre: noted. I'll own post-incident followups.

maria_support: I'll close the loop with customers when quota is confirmed and reserved pool released.

sre-bot: final metrics snapshot: p50=120ms p95=0.8s p99=1.4s queue=1. all clear.
